notes.title: Steam Playtest - Coming soon
notes.notes:
With most of the features in place we now need to start testing things out and move onto the polishing phase of the production. We’ve gotten the Steam Playtest approved but we haven't set the test live yet. Hopefully this will happen sometime next week and if you are interested in helping out you can request access from the main store page and you will get notified when the test is available. Ideally we would like to have 50 to 100 people testing the game so please help us out and share the news. Testers don’t need to pre own the game as the Playtest is treated as a separate game by Steam.

Please bare in mind that the current state of the game is beta, most of the features are in place, things need polish and proper balancing.

We hope to see you in the ring.
